summary: Diagnose same-host replication worker and daemon build skew at worker startup and in doctor. Stale process reports and missing identities warn without blocking replication.

replay.detail: No replicated authority or projection changes.

schema.detail: Worker identity is local diagnostic metadata, not replicated state.

rules.detail: No checkpoint or coordinated upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Uses the existing health build.commit identity; older workers without reports are diagnosed as unknown.

downtime.detail: Skew only warns and does not reject rolling deployments.

manual.detail: No required operator action. Deploy matching daemon and worker builds when skew is reported.

recovery.detail: No recovery or rollback behavior changes.
